visualCharacteristics.purpose: Intro copy with rating plus tax-situation checkboxes that filter software recommendations

contentPattern.structure: One row: intro (optional rating line "4.3 (495170)", heading, text) | list of situations (one per item). Selections update ?situations= and fire software-finder:change; elements with data-situations get .software-finder-match

reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
